course.title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
course.target_audience: IT professionals transitioning to cloud technologies

learning_objectives.objective: Define cloud computing and explain its key characteristics
Differentiate between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS service models
Compare public, private, hybrid, and multi-cloud deployment models
Select appropriate compute services for given workload requirements
Design storage solutions using object, block, and file storage services
Choose appropriate database services based on data model and access patterns
Configure VPC networking with proper security controls
Implement cloud security best practices including IAM and encryption
Design serverless architectures for event-driven applications
Apply cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spending
Evaluate cloud migration strategies and select appropriate approach
Apply Well-Architected Framework principles to cloud solutions
